question: Fuse coordination: do the candidate fuse ratings actually cover the normal-current waveform and a fault-impedance envelope, with applicable capacitor-discharge clearing data?
focus: 1) NORMAL-CURRENT WAVEFORM: F2 sits in the DC bus and carries the boost-diode current. Use the retained waveform model (diode RMS = 9.0007 A at 120 V; 8.5390 A at 108 V; 8.5868 A at 132 V) and compare each candidate's rating against the RMS basis Eaton itself uses, including repetitive pulses, startup and temperature. An average current is NOT a sizing basis. 2) FAULT-IMPEDANCE ENVELOPE: sweep a defensible range of the internal discharge loop's R and L (U10/U9 short residual, bank ESR, fuse resistance, layout) and compute the discharge peak and action [i^2 dt for each point, together with the assumptions (inductance, evolving resistance, arcing). Present where each candidate melts and where it clears, as an envelope with stated assumptions - not as a single resistance window. 3) APPLICABLE CLEARING DATA: obtain a capacitor-discharge clearing characteristic, or manufacturer guidance, for the candidate class at 400 Vdc. An AC/inductive clearing I2t does not apply. If unobtainable, say so and name what would resolve it. 4) REVISION: reconcile the applicable datasheet revision for each candidate. The retained FWP sheet is a 2011-2014 revision stating 800 Vdc; a current revision reportedly states 700 Vdc. Use the revision applicable to the ordered part and say which. 5) CANDIDATES: compare FWP-50A14F against at least one alternative of the same class (DC-rated semiconductor fuse) at a comparable rating. 6) EVIDENCE LEDGER (required): claims.json passing `zapote-claims`, output retained; any current/energy assignment also passing `check_fault_loop.py` with retained output. 7) State which quantities remain null and what would resolve them. Do NOT promote completion past the rung the evidence supports; 'coordination unestablished' is the expected outcome unless you can demonstrate clearing.
stop_rule: Do not size from an average current; do not present an illustrative resistance window as an interruption criterion; do not apply an AC/inductive clearing figure to a capacitor discharge; do not claim coordination without demonstrating it; do not present an unreconciled datasheet revision as the part's rating. Three candidates, ten sources, or the deadline - whichever comes first.
